title: A Multicenter Clinical Trial on Laparoscopic Gastric Cancer Surgery Compared With Open Surgery
brief_summary: evaluate the long-term efficacy and safety of oncology between D2 laparoscopic approach distal gastric resection (distal gastrectomy, D2 lymph node dissection) with the current standard surgical treatment model D2 open approach distal gastric resection (distal gastrectomy, D2 lymphadenectomy).
